description: Probe for the actuation boundary in gate mode, not part of the registered dev set. Margaret reads. One byte of the body's copy of the signed manifest is changed at 10 s and restored at 40 s. The same proposal, to go to her, is made under the lock at 20 s and after the restore at 50 s. Under the lock the gate may pass it but the body must refuse it at the act with the lock named; after the restore the body performs it.

proposals.note: under the lock: the gate may pass it, the body must refuse it
after the restore: the same proposal
